moments.title: Autumnal Equinox Marks Start of Autumn
moments.blurb: The Autumnal Equinox, marking the start of astronomical autumn in the Northern Hemisphere, occurs on Wednesday, September 23rd, 2026, at 1:06 AM BST.

angles.name: Seasonal Change
angles.copy: Mark your calendars! Astronomical autumn officially begins on Wednesday, September 23rd with the Autumnal Equinox. Time for cosy nights and changing leaves!

angles.name: First Day of Autumn
angles.copy: The days are getting shorter and the nights are drawing in. The Autumnal Equinox arrives on September 23rd, signalling the official start of autumn. What are you most looking forward to this season?

angles.name: Equinox Fact
angles.copy: On the Autumnal Equinox (September 23rd), day and night are almost equal in length. It's the turning point from summer to autumn in the Northern Hemisphere!
